tasks.short: Interview new patients and complete their admission forms.

steps.what: Read the referral and prior treatment history
Interview patients about mental health and treatment history
Assess mental health status from the interview
Complete admission forms with history and status
File the accepted admission forms in the clinical record

tasks.design: She interviews the patient and assesses mental health status herself. She types the history, the status and a contact-consent flag once into the admission form. The {OTHER} clinical record then files that accepted form on its own step. It does not record the interview and it does not judge the patient.
tasks.previous_blocker: The history is what the patient says in the room, and a form cannot hear it or decide the status.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured form in the clinical record can file the fields she has just typed, once she accepts that version.
tasks.still_hard: A frightened patient may stop talking, and only she can judge whether the history is complete.
tasks.human_edge: She notices when the spoken history and the referral do not match, and she decides what to write.

ambition.what: Record contact consent on the day of admission.

tasks.altitude: She still does the interview and the status judgement. She no longer copies the finished form into the record by hand. She does not gain a right to diagnose.

reach.learn: Which history and consent fields the technician already typed

evidence.claim: Health data are a special category, and the admission form holds health data.
Large-scale processing of health data needs a data protection impact assessment.
The medical dossier that stores the filed form is kept for 20 years.
Recording consultations can count as staff monitoring, so this design does not record the interview.
She records the status on a practitioner's instructions. The reserved act named for this rule is ionising radiation, which this task does not include.
A configured form can file the version she typed without a model judging mental status. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: Fields she types in s4, and she is the producer: presenting concern in her words, treatment history she was told, medication names she was told, risk flags she ticks, and contact consent as yes, no or unknown. If the referral has no structured name and date of birth, she types those in s4 too. Nothing is extracted by a model.
The file step stores only the admission form she finished in s4. A later edit needs a new acceptance before a new file.
Upkeep is 2 hours per 100 baseline hours of this task to keep those fields aligned with the ward dossier. The clinical record's own runtime is not her time.
unknowns: Whether this ward's admission form is still on paper.
Whether the works council must agree before the form fields change.
research_questions: Does the dossier already store contact consent as yes, no or unknown?

already_counted.description: She rereads the admission form in s4 before she accepts it.

incremental.description: Keep the admission-form fields aligned with the ward dossier.

approvals.approved_version: admission form she accepted in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the ward still uses a paper admission form, she writes and files it by hand and the record step does not run, so the saving is none. Where she already types the form once, only the separate file step is saved, and the high case is half of that net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Contact relatives to arrange family conferences.

steps.what: Read whether patients allow contact with relatives
Decide which relatives join family conferences
Phone relatives to arrange family conferences
Write the agreed family conferences time and attendees
Send relatives the confirmation of family conferences
File the accepted time for family conferences

tasks.design: She phones relatives herself and types the agreed time, purpose and attendees. The {EMAIL} sends that accepted confirmation, and the {CALENDAR} files the same note. Neither step runs unless the dossier already shows contact consent as yes.
tasks.previous_blocker: A relative's willingness and free time are not in the record until she speaks to them.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she has typed the agreed note and consent is yes, a template can send that exact note and file it on the calendar.
tasks.still_hard: A relative may be angry, hard to reach, or unwilling, and the call stays hers.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the family will and will not do, and she stops when consent is missing.
tasks.altitude: She still makes the call and chooses who should come. The confirmation and the calendar entry go only after she accepts the note. She gains no right to contact a relative without consent.

reach.learn: Which relatives agreed a time and the purpose she recorded

evidence.claim: Telling a relative the purpose of a family conference shares health data, which are a special category.
Large-scale processing of this health data needs a data protection impact assessment.
A fixed note can be sent and filed only after she accepts it. This is model knowledge, not a cited product.

assumptions: The send and the calendar file need contact consent equal to yes, plus relative name, phone and mail, purpose, agreed time and attendees. Producer of consent and contacts: the admission form the psychiatric technician typed, or the admissions clerk when the dossier already holds next of kin. If consent is not yes, neither machine step runs, and asking the patient stays inside s1.
She types the conference note in s4 before either machine step. A change to the time or the attendees voids that acceptance.
Upkeep is 3 hours per 100 baseline hours of this task for the confirmation wording and the calendar fields. Mail and calendar runtime is not her time.
unknowns: Whether this ward sends a written confirmation today, or only telephones.
Which relatives have a mail address the ward is allowed to use.
research_questions: Is contact consent already a field on the admission form, or only a sentence in a note?

already_counted.description: She rereads the conference note in s4 before she accepts it.

incremental.description: Keep the confirmation wording and calendar fields current, including bounced mail.

approvals.approved_version: conference note she accepted in s4
conference note she accepted in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If relatives have no mail address and the ward diary stays on paper, she only phones and writes the time by hand, so the saving is none. Where both the confirmation and the calendar file run, wrong numbers and refusals keep the high case at 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Her week is still interviews, status judgements and family calls. Filing the form and posting the conference are no longer a second write. Diagnosis and consent stay her judgement under the practitioner's instructions.
role.ambitious_version: Every admission she accepts carries a contact-consent flag the same day, and every family conference she accepts is on the ward calendar before the shift ends.
